    level_id = "{level_id}"
    display_name = "{display_name}"

    # [OPSIONAL] USD Map Stage URL jika level ini menggunakan file USD terpisah:
    # map_url: Optional[str] = "./assets/maps/{level_id}.usd"

    # Root prim path untuk level ini:
    root_prim_path = "{root_prim_path}"

    # 🎯 1. Objek yang dilacak koordinat layarnya untuk Web Dashboard (3D-to-2D Frustum Math):
    tracked_objects = {
        # "example_anchor": "{root_prim_path}"
    }

    # 🎯 2. Variabel warna lokal level (Direct Color Injection):
    # status_color = "#00E5FF"

    def __init__(self, manager):
        super().__init__(manager)
        self.selected_item = None

    def on_enter(self, stage: Usd.Stage, context: NavigationContext) -> None:
        print(f"[{self.level_id}] Entered. Previous level: {context.previous_level}")

        # 🎯 Setup kamera: atur poros putar dan sudut pandang
        self.set_camera_pivot(stage, pivot_point=(0.0, 0.0, 0.0), distance=800.0)
        self.set_camera_view(stage, "iso")

        if stage:
            prim = stage.GetPrimAtPath(self.root_prim_path)
            if prim.IsValid() and prim.IsA(UsdGeom.Imageable):
                UsdGeom.Imageable(prim).MakeVisible()

            # Contoh manipulasi visibilitas:
            # self.hide_objects(stage, ["/World/Roof"])

            # Contoh direct color injection:
            # self.set_color(stage, "/World/Equipment", "#FFB300")

    def on_exit(self, stage: Usd.Stage, next_level_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        print(f"[{self.level_id}] Exiting to {next_level_id}")

        # Selalu pulihkan seluruh visibilitas, warna, dan poros kamera ke kondisi awal:
        self.restore_all_visibility(stage)
        self.restore_all_colors(stage)
        self.reset_camera_pivot(stage)

        return {
            "from_level": self.level_id,
            "last_selection": self.selected_item
        }

    def on_update(self, stage: Usd.Stage, dt: float) -> None:
        # 60 FPS update loop (misal: dynamic perspective cutaway dinding)
        pass

    def on_selection_changed(self, stage: Usd.Stage, prim_path: Optional[str]) -> None:
        self.selected_item = prim_path
        super().on_selection_changed(stage, prim_path)
